elements: Role Badge Pill (Super Admin, Finance Admin, Support, etc.)
Admin Profile Dropdown with Quick Password Change & Logout

grid_strategy.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 mb-6
grid_strategy.table_grid: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm overflow-hidden

kpi_cards.pattern: High-density compact card with 1px border, 12px muted title, 28px mono numeric value, percentage change pill, and secondary contextual detail.

features: Masked Aadhaar field with toggle permission preview ('XXXX-XXXX-1234')
Status badges with semantic color fills (Paid, Pending, Verified, Rejected, Expired)
Slide-over drawer for detail view instead of full page unload

dialogs_and_modals.rule: Action approvals (Reject Agreement, Refund Payment, Deactivate Admin, Revoke Coupon) MUST require a mandatory 'Reason for Action' text area before submitting.

privacy_security_rules.aadhaar_masking: Aadhaar numbers must display as 'XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234'. Show unmask button only for Super Admin role with audit logging trigger.
privacy_security_rules.no_hard_deletes: Delete buttons perform Soft Delete only (sets is_archived: true) and log to Audit Logs. Archived records move to Archived Records section.

roles_permission_matrix: Super Admin (Full System Access, System Config, Admin Management)
Finance Admin (Payments, Finance Approval, Subscriptions, Coupons, Financial Reports)
Owner Support (Owners Directory, Property List, Support Tickets, Communications)
Tenant Support (Tenants Directory, Agreements, Leaving Requests, Complaints)
Property Management (Properties CRUD, Occupancy Tracking, Inspection Logs)
Agreement Verification (Verification Queue, Document Review, Approve/Reject)
Read-Only (View-only analytics and records, no mutation actions)
instructions_to_main_agent: Use React JS + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI primitives located in src/components/ui/ (.jsx / .js files).

Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select dropdowns, table rows, tab triggers, modal action buttons, search inputs, pagination controls) include explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="global-search-input", data-testid="approve-agreement-button").
Maintain high APCA contrast. Never use raw white text on pale backgrounds or hover states without explicit text color classes.
Implement the left sidebar containing all 17 specified sections with active state indicator using PA Blue (#1E3A8A) background and PA Kinetic Orange (#EA580C) accent badge.
For financial or agreement verification dialogs, always prompt for a mandatory reason text field before execution.
Do not use transparent background on dropdowns or floating headers; use blur glassmorphism or solid surfaces with proper border separation.
Include global historical search box in the header capable of matching owner names, tenant details, agreement IDs, and unit numbers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Layered shadows (ambient + direct) for floating dialogs and popovers.
Custom scrollbar styling; no content cutoff or unexpected layout shifts.
Use Sonner for toast notifications on all mutation events (save, approve, reject, soft delete).
